description: This source file defines the 'OpenClawNodeStorage' enum containing static methods for retrieving various application-specific directory paths such as support, cache, and snapshot directories, with session handling logic.

methods.name: appSupportDir
methods.description: Returns the URL for the application support directory 'OpenClaw', throws if unavailable.

methods.name: canvasRoot
methods.description: Returns the URL for the 'canvas' directory within the app support directory, using sessionKey to determine subpath.

methods.name: cachesDir
methods.description: Returns the URL for the 'OpenClaw' directory within caches, throws if unavailable.

methods.name: canvasSnapshotsRoot
methods.description: Returns the URL for the 'canvas-snapshots' directory within caches, using sessionKey to determine subpath.
